headline: President Prabowo Subianto Jokes About Surveillance At Nasdem Event
seoTitle: Prabowo Jokes About Surveillance At Nasdem Anniversary
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto made light-hearted comments regarding potential surveillance during his address at the 15th anniversary of the Nasdem Party.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto delivered a speech at the 15th anniversary celebration of the Nasdem Party in Jakarta.
During his address, the President made a joke regarding the possibility of being subjected to surveillance.
Reports indicate that current investigations into alleged surveillance involve four active-duty military generals.
aiContextParagraph: President Prabowo Subianto attended the 15th anniversary of the Nasdem Party held at Nasdem Tower in Central Jakarta on November 11, 2026. During his remarks, while addressing various political party leaders in attendance, the President interjected with a comment suggesting that he might be monitored or wiretapped at the venue. This light-hearted remark occurred amidst ongoing developments regarding an active investigation into surveillance activities. According to media reports, the ongoing probe being conducted by the National Police involves four active-duty generals who have been identified as suspects in the case. The President's comment drew reactions from the audience present at the commemorative event, reflecting current public and political attention toward the unfolding security investigation and its implications for high-level officials and the broader national discourse.
whyItIsViral: The story reached a viral activity score of 67/100, driven by its coverage across four independent national outlets within a short timeframe.
